title: BigBank Group: A$500m Tier 2 notes at 3M BBSW +185bps
key_takeaways: BigBank Group (ASX: BBG) prices A$500m of 10-year non-call 5-year Tier 2 subordinated notes at 3M BBSW +185bps, 15bps inside initial price thoughts of +200bps area.
Book covered more than 3x at pricing, with 62 investors; approximately 75% allocated to Australian accounts and 25% to Asian accounts.
Proceeds refinance A$450m of Tier 2 notes maturing in March 2027, strengthening BigBank's capital position ahead of APRA's upcoming Basel III finalisation rules.

sections.2_credit_story: BigBank Group is rated A- / A3 at the senior level (S&P / Moody's), consistent with a major Australian bank. The Tier 2 notes are rated two notches below the senior rating per standard methodology. S&P affirmed the rating with a stable outlook in September 2026, citing strong asset quality and capital adequacy above APRA minimums. BigBank's CET1 ratio was 12.4% as of the June 2026 half, well above the 10.25% regulatory minimum.
sections.3_process:
- **24 Oct 2026** BigBank mandated ANZ, CBA, NAB and Westpac as joint lead managers.
- **25 Oct 2026** Investor roadshow calls; IPTs released at 3M BBSW +200bps area.
- **26 Oct 2026** Books opened at 9:00am AEDT; guidance set at +190bps; priced at +185bps by 11:30am.
- **2 Nov 2026** Expected settlement.
Margin tightened 15bps from IPTs to pricing on strong book demand.
sections.4_pricing: The +185bps margin represents a modest new issue concession of approximately 5-8bps versus BigBank's existing Tier 2 curve (the March 2027 notes were trading at approximately +177bps on a like-for-like basis before announcement). The tightening from IPTs (+200bps) to pricing (+185bps) reflects robust demand. Comparable recent Tier 2 issuance from major Australian banks has priced in the +180-+195bps range.
sections.5_use_of_proceeds: Proceeds will primarily refinance the A$450m Tier 2 notes maturing in March 2027, with the A$50m surplus adding to general capital resources. The pre-financing of the March 2027 maturity removes near-term refinancing risk and locks in current spread levels ahead of anticipated APRA Basel III capital reforms.
sections.6_market_view: Secondary trading opened around +183bps (2bps through pricing), consistent with a well-received deal. The 3x+ oversubscription and 62-investor book indicate strong institutional demand. The four-bank syndicate structure is standard for major bank Tier 2 issuance; a wider syndicate was not warranted given domestic demand absorption.
sections.7_outlook: Post-settlement, BigBank's Tier 2 capital stack is fully refinanced until at least 2031. No further Tier 2 issuance is expected in the near term. The next capital market event is the February 2027 senior benchmark update. Management has flagged potential Additional Tier 1 (AT1) issuance in H1 2027 to replace legacy hybrid securities as APRA's AT1 reform framework is finalised.
